---
title: "Other holdings"
toc: false
---

These products are on the WHOI store but are **not in the intake catalog**,
so they are not on the [Browse](browse.qmd) page. Open the files directly on
the HPC cluster at the path shown (see [Access](access.qmd)). Some may be
added to the catalog later. Cite each product as given below; see also
[How to cite](cite.qmd).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Served from site/vendor/ (see vendor/vendor.yml) instead of jsDelivr.
vendor = (p) => new URL(`vendor/${p}`, document.baseURI).href
htl = require(vendor("htl/htl.min.js"))
html = htl.html
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
config = FileAttachment("data/site_config.json").json()
// products.json: summarize_catalog.py --products (curated, every build).
// holdings.json: summarize_other.py --site-json (measured, when the
// inventory is re-run). Either may be missing in an older build.
getJson = (p, empty) => fetch(p).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : empty)).catch(() => empty)
products = getJson("data/products.json", {})
holdings = getJson("data/holdings.json", {products: {}})
rows = Object.entries(products)
  .filter(([, p]) => !p.catalogued && p.path)
  .map(([name, p]) => ({name, ...p, inv: holdings.products?.[name] ?? null}))
  .sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fmt = (x, d = 0) => x.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: d})
none = html`<em>not recorded yet</em>`
html`<p class="small text-body-secondary">${rows.length} products.
${holdings.generated
  ? `File counts and sizes from the inventory of ${holdings.generated}.`
  : "File counts and sizes are not available yet."}</p>
${rows.map((r) => html`<div class="holding mb-4">
  <h3 id="${r.name}" class="h5 mb-1"><code>${r.name}</code></h3>
  <p class="mb-1">${r.description ?? ""}</p>
  <table class="table table-sm w-auto small mb-1"><tbody>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Path</th><td><code style="word-break: break-all;">${config.vast_prefix}/${r.path}</code></td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Years</th><td>${r.years ?? "—"}</td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Files</th><td>${r.inv
      ? `${fmt(r.inv.n_nc)} NetCDF${r.inv.n_other ? `, ${fmt(r.inv.n_other)} other` : ""}; ${fmt(r.inv.size_tb, 2)} TB`
      : "—"}</td></tr>
    ${r.caveats ? html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Caveats</th><td>${r.caveats}</td></tr>` : ""}
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Citation</th><td>${r.citation ?? none}</td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">License</th><td>${r.license ?? none}</td></tr>
    ${r.acknowledgment ? html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Acknowledgment</th><td>${r.acknowledgment}</td></tr>` : ""}
  </tbody></table>
</div>`)}`
```
